description: Styles an authored `<table>` in place: write the `caption`, `thead`, `tbody`, and `th scope` yourself, and the table reads as a table before JavaScript and to a screen reader. A cell's `data-ui-align` (`start`, `center`, or `end`; `start` when unset) sets its content along the row, such as `end` for a column of figures; compose a value with a muted line beneath it from [Text](/components/ui-text). Table is presentation only: it does not sort, page, or select rows.
